evals.prompt: Pinterest just added DELETE /pins/{pin_id}/comments/{comment_id}. Add a 'Delete Comment' operation to the Pin resource end to end.
evals.expected_output: A new operation option and required pinId/commentId fields in PinDescriptions.ts, a requests/pin/deleteComment.ts builder returning a DELETE request, exports from the pin and top-level barrels, a dispatch case in Pinterest.node.ts, and clean lint/build. No pagination helper.

evals.prompt: The board update operation should accept a new optional 'category' string field. Wire it through the editor and the request body.
evals.expected_output: A category field inside the board:update additionalFields collection and a conditional body.category assignment that omits empty values, with no changes to other operations.

evals.prompt: Add a new Conversion Tag resource with List and Get operations. The list endpoint returns { items, bookmark } and supports page_size up to 250.
evals.expected_output: A ConversionTagDescriptions.ts with resource selector wiring, two builders, barrel exports, a resource option/spread and a nested switch in execute(), returnAll/limit fields, a collectConversionTagPages helper, and clean lint/build.

evals.prompt: Make userAccount:listFollowers return every follower when Return All is enabled, and still respect Limit otherwise.
evals.expected_output: Confirmation that the existing returnAll/limit fields and collectFollowersPages helper already implement this, or a corrected helper/description pair if they do not; pagination stays bookmark-based and terminates on repeated bookmarks.
